title: On-prem workload fidelity injector for reproducible KV/cache contention and regression detection
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Build an on-prem 'workload fidelity injector' that can reproduce customer environment characteristics (concurrency mix, prefix cache hit patterns, KV cache contention, tokenization distributions) deterministically across Private/VPC deployments. The goal is to: 1) measure tokens/sec and tail latencies (p95/p99) under realistic contention, 2) produce artifactized runs that can be replayed by SREs or customers, and 3) wire regression detection into CI and the Console so performance drifts trigger alerts. This is distinct from prior replay runners: instead of trying to replay entire request streams verbatim, the injector synthesizes request mixes and contention signals to exercise the runtime's worst-case scheduling and cache eviction behavior while remaining reproducible via seeds and environment fingerprints.
acceptance_criteria: Injector runs produce deterministic artifacts (seed, env-fingerprint, config) that reproduce key metrics within 5% across runs
Metrics pipeline records tokens/sec, median, p95, p99, and per-model KV cache hit rate for each run
Console dashboard exists that compares baseline vs candidate runs and highlights regressions over configured thresholds
CI job runs a smoke suite that fails on >8% regression in tokens/sec or >15% increase in p95 for guarded queries
Run artifacts (logs, tracer spans, generated workload files) uploaded to S3 and linked from the Linear ticket and Console run view
Playbook document for running the injector in customer VPC/on-prem with limited privileges is written and reviewed by Security
test_plan_steps: Design injector config model: concurrency mix, qps ramp, KV key-space skew, prefix/cache warmup policy, token length distribution
Implement deterministic seeding across all RNG sources (request order, content selection, timing jitter) and record seed in run manifest
Add contention primitives: synthetic KV read/write noise, artificial large-batch requests to create memory pressure, adjustable eviction bias
Integrate with telemetry (Prometheus/Datadog) for tokens/sec, token latency histograms, KV cache metrics, GPU utilization, queue depth
Create run CLI that accepts an env-fingerprint and emits run artifacts and a bundled tarball for uploading
Create Console run importer to display baseline vs candidate comparison and expose regression alerts
Author CI wrapper that runs subset of injector scenarios in a quenched mode for quick feedback on PRs that touch scheduling/kernel selection code
